rows.note: For something belonging to the beginning or first version, this is the all-purpose choice; use it for the initial state and for the version before later changes.

example.english: This was the original design; it was changed later.
example.traditional: 呢個係原本嘅設計，後來先改過。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jyun4 bun2 ge3 cit3 gai3 hau6 loi4 sin1 goi2 gwo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the original document, manuscript, or copy rather than a reproduction.

example.english: I want to look at the original of this document.
example.traditional: 我想睇返呢份文件嘅原本。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tai2 faan1 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 ge3 jyun4 bun2

rows.note: Use this for the original physical object when contrasting it with a replica or copy.

example.english: This is the original object, not a replica.
example.traditional: 呢件係原物，唔係複製品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hai6 jyun4 mat6 m4 hai6 fuk1 zai3 ban2

rows.note: Use this for the original creative work behind later adaptations, versions, or copies.

example.english: This film was adapted from the original.
example.traditional: 呢套電影係根據原作改編嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai6 gan1 geoi3 jyun4 zok3 goi2 pin1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the contrast is between an original edition or version and later reproductions or adaptations.

example.english: I still keep the original edition of this book.
example.traditional: 我仲保留住呢本書嘅原版。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 bou2 lau4 zyu6 ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jyun4 baan2

rows.note: Use this when original means inventive, imaginative, or different from ordinary ideas.

example.english: Your idea is really original—you turned old things into something so nice.
example.traditional: 你個諗法真係有創意，將舊物變到咁靚。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 nam2 faat3 zan1 hai6 jau5 cong3 ji3 zoeng1 gau6 mat6 bin3 dou3 gam3 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a newly created work rather than a copy or adaptation.

example.english: This comic is original, not adapted from a novel.
example.traditional: 呢套漫畫係原創，唔係改編自小說。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 maan6 waa2 hai6 jyun4 cong3 m4 hai6 goi2 pin1 zi6 siu2 syut3

rows.note: Use this when something is native or indigenous to the place being discussed, especially in contrast with foreign varieties.

example.english: This local snack is a Hong Kong original, not an imported product.
example.traditional: 呢款本土小食係香港嘅，唔係入口貨。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 bun2 tou2 siu2 sik6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 m4 hai6 jap6 hau2 fo3
